name: Light front-drive four
notes: A light front-drive hatchback with a manual six: 1150 kg, 62 % on the front, street tyres, an open front differential. The numbers are a typical small hatchback's (published curb weights, wheelbases and drag areas of the class), not one model's. The car part of a build: pair it with an engine of some 1.6 L.
